WoW: Forever

Assassination Rogue

Poison and bleed pressure on a single target, built around MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantRangeMelee. It needs 21 Assassination talent points, which is the whole argument about this spec.

WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated October 8, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70245 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Assassination build has been tested. Talent rows unlock at levels 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 and 40. No source has published a level 30 build, so the level 30 line below extends the published level 20 one on the tree's own point costs.

What Assassination is for

Poison and bleed pressure on one target, opened from StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled.. AmbushAmbushSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMeleeAmbush the target, causing 160 damage. at level 18 is where the build starts to work. At 21 Assassination points MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantRangeMelee becomes the builder: 60 Energy, both weapons at once, 2 combo points, and extra damage on a poisoned target. Blizzard attaches no figures to it: the 75% weapon damage per hand and the +20% in the table below are client readings. Cold BloodCold BloodTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledWhen activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%. is now the 16-point gold medal talent, so level 25. It guarantees a crit on your next Sinister StrikeSinister StrikeSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost45 ManaRangeMeleeInflicts normal damage plus 1 to an enemy., BackstabBackstabSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9Cast3 sec castCost60 ManaRangeMeleeTeaches Backstab (Rank 9)., AmbushAmbushSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMeleeAmbush the target, causing 160 damage., EviscerateEviscerateSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMeleeEviscerates an enemy, inflicting 2 Physical damage. or MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantRangeMelee.

The sources disagree about this spec.

For: Icy Veins rates its levelling 4 out of 5, tied with Combat's 4 out of 5, and both specs sit at 3.0 Overall. It says "Assassination is likely to be very strong especially in this level bracket due to the potency of talents like Remorseless AttacksRemorseless AttacksTalentCastInstant."

Against: Wowhead, updated 2026/09/29, says "Assassination is wholly underwhelming at this level bracket. We don't have any of our essential kit, such as MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantRangeMelee, VenomVenomTalentCastInstantCost25 ManaRange100 yd rangeDuration6 secFinishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 9 sec 2 points: 12 sec 3 points: 15 sec 4 points: 18 sec 5 points: 21 sec, and Seal FateSeal FateTalentCastInstant. It will ultimately play the same as the Combat Rogue for now until we can gain access to some more impactful abilities."

Both agree on why 21 points matters: that is what MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantRangeMelee costs in the tree (ClassicWoW.gg), and that is exactly level 30, the beta cap. Below that, Assassination leans on MaliceMaliceTalentCastInstantIncreases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%., Remorseless AttacksRemorseless AttacksTalentCastInstant and LethalityLethalityTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 6%.: good passive numbers with no signature button. Our own reading, not a source's: Combat is the lower-risk levelling pick, and Assassination pays off once MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantRangeMelee is reachable.

Rotation

At level 20 all three Rogue specs play the same. Icy Veins says so on its own Assassination guide. Wowhead's three level-20 guides confirm it by being largely interchangeable: "During the early stages of Rogue leveling, it is difficult to really differentiate the specializations."

  1. From 20, Instant PoisonInstant PoisonItem on both weapons
  2. Open from StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. with AmbushAmbushSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost60 ManaRangeMeleeAmbush the target, causing 160 damage.
  3. BackstabBackstabSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9Cast3 sec castCost60 ManaRangeMeleeTeaches Backstab (Rank 9). behind the target, otherwise Sinister StrikeSinister StrikeSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost45 ManaRangeMeleeInflicts normal damage plus 1 to an enemy.
  4. At 5 combo points, Slice and DiceSlice and DiceSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 2CastInstantCost25 ManaRange100 yd rangeCooldown60 sec cooldownDuration10 secIncreases the caster's attack speed by 30% for 10 sec. if the target will survive its duration
  5. Otherwise EviscerateEviscerateSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMeleeEviscerates an enemy, inflicting 2 Physical damage. at 5 combo points

Once MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantRangeMelee is reachable, it becomes your builder in place of Backstab/Sinister Strike, with Slice and DiceSlice and DiceSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 2CastInstantCost25 ManaRange100 yd rangeCooldown60 sec cooldownDuration10 secIncreases the caster's attack speed by 30% for 10 sec. upkeep unchanged.

Multi-target: no source publishes an Assassination area rotation. Remorseless AttacksRemorseless AttacksTalentCastInstant "heavily incentivizes pulling multiple mobs", but that rewards chain-killing rather than cleaving.

Stat priority

Weapon damage, then Hit and Expertise, Agility, critical strike, Strength, Stamina.

Published gear advice adds: slow main hand, fast off hand, and "Intellect and Spirit are wasted on a rogue."

What Forever changed for Rogues

  • Poisons and Lockpicking are secondary skills now, "like First Aid", not class skills. Poison damage is lower with more charges: Instant PoisonInstant PoisonItem rank 1 is "13 to 17 instead of 19 to 25, 60 instead of 40". Blizzard has since raised the charges on every poison again. A poison and a sharpening stone now go on the same weapon. Improved PoisonsImproved PoisonsTalentCastInstantIncreases the chance to apply Poisons to your target by 10%, and gives Poison applications a 50% chance to not consume a charge. gives a large chance for a poison not to spend a charge when it fires, because Blizzard wants "Assassination to be a Poison-focused playstyle."
  • MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantRangeMelee and VenomVenomTalentCastInstantCost25 ManaRange100 yd rangeDuration6 secFinishing move that increases the damage of your Poisons by 30% and your chance to apply Poisons by 10%. Lasts longer per combo point: 1 point : 9 sec 2 points: 12 sec 3 points: 15 sec 4 points: 18 sec 5 points: 21 sec are both new, and MaliceMaliceTalentCastInstantIncreases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%., LethalityLethalityTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 6%., Remorseless AttacksRemorseless AttacksTalentCastInstant and Cold BloodCold BloodTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledWhen activated, increases the critical strike chance of your next Sinister Strike, Backstab, Ambush, Eviscerate, or Mutilate by 100%. were each extended to cover MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantRangeMelee. LethalityLethalityTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike damage bonus of your Sinister Strike, Gouge, Backstab, Mutilate, Ghostly Strike, and Hemorrhage abilities by 6%.'s critical-damage bonus came down in the same pass.
  • MaliceMaliceTalentCastInstantIncreases your critical strike chance with all attacks and Poisons by 5%. now raises crit with all attacks and your Poisons, not melee alone. MurderMurderTalentCastInstantIncreases all damage dealt by 4% against Humanoid and Giant targets. gained Giants and lost Beasts and Dragonkin, a loss on levelling targets. VigorVigorTalentCastInstantIncreases your maximum Energy by 10. is a 2-point row 5 talent instead of the 31-point capstone, for the same total effect.
  • Improved GougeImproved GougeTalentCastInstantIncreases the duration of your Gouge ability by 1.5 sec. moved in from Combat to row 1; Improved EviscerateImproved EviscerateTalentCastInstantIncreases the damage done by your Eviscerate ability by 20%. moved out to Combat. Puncturing WoundsPuncturing WoundsTalentCastInstantIncreases the critical strike chance of your Backstab by 30% and your Mutilate by 15%, and gives Backstab a 45% chance to add an additional Combo Point. is Combat's renamed Improved BackstabImproved BackstabTalentCastInstantRange50000 yd range, and it now raises MutilateMutilateLevel 30 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantRangeMelee's crit chance too, so the two trees talk to each other.
  • Rogues can learn axes, and the skill starts at 1.
  • Baseline nerfs: RuptureRuptureSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost25 ManaRangeMeleeDuration10 secInflicts Physical damage to an enemy every 2 sec. for 10 sec. rank 6 is "159 instead of 272"; EviscerateEviscerateSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 9CastInstantCost35 ManaRangeMeleeEviscerates an enemy, inflicting 2 Physical damage. rank 6 was lowered. Expose ArmorExpose ArmorLevel 14 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost25 ManaRangeMeleeDuration30 sec was buffed instead, to match five Sunder ArmorSunder ArmorLevel 10 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost150 ManaRangeMeleeDuration30 secSunders the target's armor, reducing it by 90 per Sunder Armor and causes a high amount of threat. Can be applied up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.s at the same level. It no longer stops a Warrior using Sunder, which cannot overwrite your Expose Armor unless yours is the weaker effect. The Improved Expose ArmorImproved Expose ArmorTalentCastInstant talent no longer adds armor reduction at all: it cuts the Energy cost and refunds combo points when you spend five. Fixed October 1: a missed Expose Armor no longer costs you all your combo points, so it is safe to throw at low hit chance.
  • Hit and critical strike are now unified across spell, melee and ranged.

At level 60

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other.
